executivePulse.interpretation: The situation in memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the most constrained areas. The daily check of 2026-08-25 reviewed eight relevant reports; there is currently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure, but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
